package_version.help: Version of quantseq-counts that wrote these settings; a run refuses another version unless told to accept it.

run_name.help: Short name of this run, used in the report (letters, digits, - and _).

fastq_dir.help: Folder on the server holding the FASTQ files.

samples.help: The sample list (samples.csv: sample, fastq, optional group).

outdir.help: Folder where the results of this run are written; it must not hold a finished run.

library.help: Library type: QuantSeq FWD with UMI (fwd_umi) or without UMI (fwd_no_umi).

reference.help: Human reference: Ensembl 115 downloaded by the package (ensembl_115) or your own files (custom).

fasta.help: Genome FASTA of a custom human reference.

gtf.help: Gene annotation (GTF) of a custom human reference.

reference_dir.help: Folder where the reference and its STAR index are kept and reused between runs.

engine.help: Container engine: apptainer (usual on servers without root), udocker, or docker.

executor.help: Where the jobs run: on this server (local) or through a SLURM queue (slurm).

max_cpus.help: Most cores the run may use at once on this server.

max_memory.help: Most memory the run may use at once on this server (for example 64 GB).

slurm_account.help: SLURM account to charge, if your cluster asks for one.

udocker_dir.help: Folder where udocker keeps its images (empty: inside the installation).

umi_pattern.help: UMI-tools regular expression: 6 UMI bases, then 4 spacer bases discarded.

dedup_algo.help: UMICollapse grouping algorithm (dir = directional, as UMI-tools).

trim_adapter.help: Adapter sequence removed by Trim Galore.

star_extra_args.help: Extra STAR arguments: mismatch limit and poly(A) clipping, as Lexogen recommends.

star_threads.help: Threads for STAR (empty: the cores given to the alignment task).

strand.help: Strand of the reads relative to the gene; QuantSeq FWD reads are forward.
strand.warning: QuantSeq FWD reads are on the gene's strand: counting them as reverse or unstranded gives wrong counts.

count_multimappers.help: Count reads that align to several places (featureCounts -M).
count_multimappers.warning: Counting reads that align to several places adds reads whose gene is uncertain; the standard drops them.

dedup_without_umi.help: No-UMI libraries only: remove duplicates by position alone.
dedup_without_umi.warning: Without UMIs, reads at the same position are often different molecules in a 3' library: removing them by position loses real counts.

deterministic_sort.help: Sort alignments by read name, then by position, before deduplication, so reruns give identical counts.
deterministic_sort.warning: Without the name-then-position sort, the read kept among duplicates follows thread scheduling: reruns can differ by a few counts.

keep_bams.help: Keep the alignment files (BAM) in the output folder.

keep_trimmed_fastq.help: Keep the trimmed reads in the output folder (used by the release check).

min_trimmed_reads.help: Libraries with fewer reads after trimming are not aligned and are reported as excluded.

skip_rseqc.help: Skip RSeQC (read distribution and other checks).
